Step 1: Extract relevant information.
- Item 2 (dated 2023-05-20, a Saturday): the user says "I had a doctor's appointment last Monday, so I took a half-day off from work and got back to the office around 1:00 PM." This gives the time they returned to the office, not the time they reached the clinic.
- Item 1 (2023-05-30): the user wants to reschedule a follow-up appointment and says it took two hours to get to the clinic last time. No arrival time is given.

Step 2: Reason.
- The Monday appointment was the one before 2023-05-20, which is Monday 2023-05-15.
- The only time mentioned is returning to the office around 1:00 PM. Travel took about two hours each way, but the memory doesn't say when the user left home or when the appointment was. That means the clinic arrival time can't be computed. The return trip (clinic to office) could be about two hours, which would put departure from the clinic around 11:00 AM. That is only a guess, because the office and home may be in different places and the return duration isn't stated.

Step 3: Conclusion.
The memory doesn't say what time you reached the clinic on Monday. It only says you got back to the office around 1:00 PM after the appointment, and that the trip to the clinic from home took about two hours. I'd need to know when you left or when your appointment was to answer that.
